verses.sloka: एवमुक्तो हनुमता रामो दशरथात्मजः ।तं मणिं हृदये कृत्वा प्ररुरोद सलक्ष्मणः ।। ५.६६.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamukto hanumatā rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ ।taṁ maṇiṁ hṛdaye kṛtvā praruroda salakṣmaṇaḥ ।। 5.66.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Thus addressed by Hanuman, Rama held the token (Chudamani) against his bosom and wept with Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: हनुमान्‌ जी द्वारा यथावत्‌ कहे हुए वचन सुन श्रीरामचन्द्र जी अत्यन्त प्रसन्न हुए ओर प्रिय सवाद सुनने क अनन्तर सप्रयोचित यह वचन बोले

verses.sloka: तं तु दृष्ट्वा मणिश्रेष्ठं राघवः शोककर्शितः ।नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत् ।। ५.६६.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ tu dṛṣṭvā maṇiśreṣṭhaṁ rāghavaḥ śokakarśitaḥ ।netrābhyāmaśrupūrṇābhyāṁ sugrīvamidamabravīt ।। 5.66.2 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the precious jewel, Rama's eyes were filled with tears. Overwhelmed with grief, he spoke to Sugriva.
translations.hindi: देखो, हनुमान जी ने ऐसा बड़ा काम किया है, जिसे इस प्रथिवीतल पर तो कोई कर नहीं सकता । करना तो जहाँ तहा, ऐसा काम करने की इस संसार में कोई कल्पना भी नहीं कर सकता

verses.sloka: यथैव धेनुः स्रवति स्नेहाद्वत्सस्य वत्सला ।तथा ममापि हृदयं मणिरत्नस्य दर्शनात् ।। ५.६६.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yathaiva dhenuḥ sravati snehādvatsasya vatsalā ।tathā mamāpi hṛdayaṁ maṇiratnasya darśanāt ।। 5.66.3 ।।।।

translations.english: "Just as a cow fond of its calf begins to distil milk from its teats at the sight of the calf, so does my heart melt at the sight of this excellent jewel.

verses.sloka: मणिरत्नमिदं दत्तं वैदेह्याः श्वशुरेण मे ।वधूकाले यथा बद्धमधिकं मूर्ध्नि शोभते ।। ५.६६.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: maṇiratnamidaṁ dattaṁ vaidehyāḥ śvaśureṇa me ।vadhūkāle yathā baddhamadhikaṁ mūrdhni śobhate ।। 5.66.4 ।।।।

translations.english: "At the time of marriage, this jewel was presented by my father-in-law. Vaidehi wore it on her forehead and it looked charming.
translations.hindi: देवता, दानव, यक्ष, गन्धर्व, उरग और राक्षस भी जिस लङ्कापुरी में नहीं पहुँच सकते, रावण द्वारा रकित उसी लङ्कापुरी में

verses.sloka: अयं हि जलसम्भूतो मणिः सज्जनपूजितः ।यज्ञे परमतुष्टेन दत्तः शक्रेण धीमता ।। ५.६६.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ayaṁ hi jalasambhūto maṇiḥ sajjanapūjitaḥ ।yajñe paramatuṣṭena dattaḥ śakreṇa dhīmatā ।। 5.66.5 ।।।।

translations.english: "This was found in water and was bestowed by Indra out of great joy on Janaka who had performed a grand sacrificial ceremony. So it was worshipped by elders of the family.
translations.hindi: पहुँच ज्ञाता हुआ यहाँ से कोन लोट क्षकता हे ?

verses.sloka: इमं दृष्ट्वा मणिश्रेष्ठं यथा तातस्य दर्शनम् ।अद्यास्म्यवगतः सौम्य वैदेहस्य तथा विभोः ।। ५.६६.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: imaṁ dṛṣṭvā maṇiśreṣṭhaṁ yathā tātasya darśanam ।adyāsmyavagataḥ saumya vaidehasya tathā vibhoḥ ।। 5.66.6 ।।।।

translations.english: "O noble Sugriva now when I see this excellent jewel, I get direct sight of my father and king of Videha (in the same way as I obtained the sight of Sita).
translations.hindi: हनुमान्‌ के समान बलवान ओर पराक्रमी, और ऐसा कोन है, जो अकेला, उस दुर्धध नगरी में, घुस भी सके, जो राक्षसो द्वारा सुरक्षित हे

verses.sloka: अयं हि शोभते तस्याः प्रियाया मूर्ध्नि मे मणिः ।अस्याद्य दर्शनेनाहं प्राप्तां तामिव चिन्तये ।। ५.६६.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ayaṁ hi śobhate tasyāḥ priyāyā mūrdhni me maṇiḥ ।asyādya darśanenāhaṁ prāptāṁ tāmiva cintaye ।। 5.66.7 ।।।।

translations.english: "This jewel was shining on the head of my beloved. Now its mere look makes me feel that I am seeing her.
translations.hindi: निश्‍्चच ही इस प्रकार अपने विक्रम के योग्य वल प्रदर्शन कर, हनुमान्‌ जी ने सुग्रीव का बड़ा भारी श्रत्यकार्य ( चाकरी ) किया है

verses.sloka: किमाह सीता वैदेही ब्रूहि सौम्य पुनः पुनः ।पिपासुमिव तोयेन सिञ्चन्ति वाक्यवारिणा ।। ५.६६.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kimāha sītā vaidehī brūhi saumya punaḥ punaḥ ।pipāsumiva toyena siñcanti vākyavāriṇā ।। 5.66.8 ।।।।

translations.english: "O handsome Hanuman Sita is like water for a thirsty person. Tell me again and again what Sita said to you. Sprinkle on me (lifegiving) water of her words in the form of message.
translations.hindi: जो श्रत्य, अपने मालिक द्वारा किसी कठिन काम को करने के लिए नियुक्त किए जाने पर, उस काम को जी लगा कर, € ००५ है डालता है, वह सवो त्तम सेवक कहलाता है

verses.sloka: इतस्तु किं दुःखतरं यदिमं वारिसम्भवम् ।मणिं पश्यामि सौमित्रे वैदेहीमागतं विना ।। ५.६६.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: itastu kiṁ duḥkhataraṁ yadimaṁ vārisambhavam ।maṇiṁ paśyāmi saumitre vaidehīmāgataṁ vinā ।। 5.66.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Saumitri I see this jewel born (formed) under water but not her. What can be more sorrowful to me?

verses.sloka: चिरं जीवति वैदेही यदि मासं धरिष्यति ।क्षणं सौम्य न जीवेयं विना तामसितेक्षणाम् ।। ५.६६.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ciraṁ jīvati vaidehī yadi māsaṁ dhariṣyati ।kṣaṇaṁ saumya na jīveyaṁ vinā tāmasitekṣaṇām ।। 5.66.10 ।।।।

translations.english: (Addressing Hanuman again) "O dear, if she can live for a month it is living for long. I would not live for a moment without the black-eyed Vaidehi.

verses.sloka: नय मामपि तं देशं यत्र दृष्टा मम प्रिया ।न तिष्ठेयं क्षणमपि प्रवृत्तिमुपलभ्य च ।। ५.६६.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: naya māmapi taṁ deśaṁ yatra dṛṣṭā mama priyā ।na tiṣṭheyaṁ kṣaṇamapi pravṛttimupalabhya ca ।। 5.66.11 ।।।।

translations.english: "Take me to the place you saw my beloved. Knowing where she is I cannot stay here even for a moment.
translations.hindi: परन्तु हनुमान जी ने राज्याज्ञा में नियुक्त होकर अपना कतव्य कार्य यथावत्‌ पूरा किआ है.। इनको कहीँ भी नीचा नहीं देखना पड़ा । अतः इन्होने सुग्रीव को भी सन्तुष्ट किआ है

verses.sloka: कथं सा मम सुश्रोणी भीरुभीरुः सती सदा ।भयावहानां घोराणां मध्ये तिष्ठति रक्षसाम् ।। ५.६६.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kathaṁ sā mama suśroṇī bhīrubhīruḥ satī sadā ।bhayāvahānāṁ ghorāṇāṁ madhye tiṣṭhati rakṣasām ।। 5.66.12 ।।।।

translations.english: "She is always very timid. How can my fairhipped beloved remain in the midst of dreadful and fearsome demons?

verses.sloka: शारदस्तिभिरोन्मुक्तो नूनं चन्द्र इवाम्बुदैः ।आवृतं वदनं तस्या न विराजति राक्षसैः ।। ५.६६.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śāradastibhironmukto nūnaṁ candra ivāmbudaiḥ ।āvṛtaṁ vadanaṁ tasyā na virājati rākṣasaiḥ ।। 5.66.13 ।।।।

translations.english: "Her face resembling the autumnal Moon bereft of its stain, though covered with rainclouds does not shine so bright.
translations.hindi: हनुमान जी के जानकी को दैख आने से में तथा बलवान लक्ष्मण तथा अन्य रघुवंशियों का धम बच गया ( अथवा हम न न >> ज १ धर्मतः परिरक्षिताः--धमेस्यापित्ाः | (गोश ] ३. चाट खाट हुन ज इदं तु मम दीनस्य मनो भूयः प्रकर्षति । यदिहास्य ग्रियाख्यातुने कुमिं सदां प्रियस्‌

verses.sloka: किमाह सीता हनुंस्तत्त्वतः कथयाद्य मे ।एतेन खलु जीविष्ये भेषजेनातुरो यथा ।। ५.६६.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kimāha sītā hanuṁstattvataḥ kathayādya me ।etena khalu jīviṣye bheṣajenāturo yathā ।। 5.66.14 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Hanuman Tell me now truly what has been told by her. I am eager to know. Indeed, it will keep me alive just as medicne does. (I shall survive on the strength of her message)
translations.hindi: जो हो, इस समय, मेरा यह सबस्त्रदान रूप आलिङ्गन ही महात्मा ( महाबली) हनुमान जी के कायं के योग्य पुरस्कार हो

verses.sloka: मधुरा मधुरालापा किमाह मम भामिनी ।मद्विहीना वरारोहा हनुमन् कथयस्व मे ।। ५.६६.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: madhurā madhurālāpā kimāha mama bhāminī ।madvihīnā varārohā hanuman kathayasva me ।। 5.66.15 ।।

translations.english: That lovely Sita who speaks sweetly, that fairhipped beautiful one who has been separated from me, my beloved, what did she say? Please narrate. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षट्षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtysixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
